description: This is a C++ source file containing unit tests for the minidump_writer component of the breakpad crash reporting system. It tests minidump creation, mapping info, memory inclusion, binary handling, and size limiting.

classes.name: MinidumpWriterTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for minidump writer unit tests.

methods.name: SetupWithPath
methods.description: Tests writing a minidump to a specified file path.

methods.name: SetupWithFD
methods.description: Tests writing a minidump to a file descriptor.

methods.name: MappingInfo
methods.description: Tests including mapping info in the minidump and verifying it appears correctly.

methods.name: MappingInfoContained
methods.description: Tests overriding existing mappings with specified mapping info.

methods.name: DeletedBinary
methods.description: Tests minidump creation after deleting the binary used for crash.

methods.name: AdditionalMemory
methods.description: Tests including additional memory regions in the minidump.

methods.name: InvalidStackPointer
methods.description: Tests minidump creation with an invalid thread stack pointer.

methods.name: MinidumpSizeLimit
methods.description: Tests limiting the size of the generated minidump.
